newsitem.title: POLAND: FARM FOOD TO BUY MIESTAR MEET FIRM.
newsitem.headline: FARM FOOD TO BUY MIESTAR MEET FIRM.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry has chosen meat processing firm Farm Food SA to become the strategic investor for meat processing firm Zaklady Miesne Miestar SA>, Farm Food said in a statement on Tuesday.
The statement gave no other details and no one at Farm Food company was immediately available for comment.
In September the privatisation ministry, the precursor to the treasury ministry, invited bids for up to 55 percent in Miestar, based in Tarnow, southeastern Poland.

The ministry invited bids for at least 10 percent stakes in the firm and earmarked up to 20 percent of the company's shares for employees, 20 percent for farm producers cooperating with the company and five percent for reprivatisation claims.
